greeting.text: Good evening, and welcome to the table. I'm Dragge, take any seat you like.

placebets.text: Bets are open. Place your chips whenever you're ready.

goodluck.text: No more bets. Here come the cards.

sidebet.text: Your side bet comes in. That one pays straight away.

insurance.text: Ace showing. Would anyone like insurance?

double.text: Doubling down. One card, and one card only.

bust.text: Over twenty-one, I'm afraid. That hand is done.

blackjack.text: Blackjack! Beautifully done. That pays three to two.

dealerblackjack.text: Dealer has blackjack. I'm sorry, everyone.

dealerbust.text: Dealer busts! Everyone still in the hand gets paid.

win.text: Well played. That hand is yours.

push.text: Same total. It's a push, your stake stays with you.

lose.text: Dealer wins. That one goes to the house.

peek.text: One moment while I check for blackjack.

farewell.text: Thank you for playing. It was a pleasure dealing for you.

chatter1.text: Quiet night at the table. Those are my favourite.

chatter2.text: Take your time. The cards aren't going anywhere.
